issues.message: Surface PEC copper, rectangular board bounds, selected nets and a finite absorbing region need mesh convergence and physical correlation.
Imported dielectric loss tangent was not represented; insertion loss is incomplete.
Relative far-field pattern is not a calibrated EMI compliance prediction.
Dielectric surroundings are explicit ideal boxes without measured dispersion or loss; compare with a bare case and refine the mesh and air domain.
